_meta.description: Universal product metrics — apply to any industry. Based on AARRR framework + dbt metric types.

metrics.name: Daily Active Users (DAU)
metrics.description_hint: Unique users who performed any meaningful action on a given day. Core pulse metric — if DAU drops, something is wrong.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT DATE({time_col}) AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT {user_col}) AS dau FROM {table} WHERE {event_col} = '{matched_event}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Weekly Active Users (WAU)
metrics.description_hint: Unique users active in a rolling 7-day window. Less noisy than DAU for products with weekly usage patterns.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT DATE({time_col}) AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT {user_col}) AS wau FROM {table} WHERE {event_col} = '{matched_event}' AND DATE({time_col}) BETWEEN DATE(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 days') AND CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY 1

metrics.name: Monthly Active Users (MAU)
metrics.description_hint: Unique users active in a calendar month. Standard investor-facing metric. DAU/MAU ratio above 20% indicates strong daily habit.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', {time_col}) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT {user_col}) AS mau FROM {table} WHERE {event_col} = '{matched_event}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: DAU/MAU Stickiness Ratio
metrics.description_hint: Percentage of monthly users who are active daily. Consumer apps aim for 50%+, SaaS for 20%+. Best single indicator of habit formation.
metrics.sql_template: WITH dau AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT {user_col}) AS n FROM {table} WHERE {event_col} = '{matched_event}' AND DATE({time_col}) = CURRENT_DATE), mau AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT {user_col}) AS n FROM {table} WHERE {event_col} = '{matched_event}' AND DATE({time_col}) >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)) SELECT ROUND(dau.n * 100.0 / NULLIF(mau.n, 0), 1) AS dau_mau_pct FROM dau, mau

metrics.name: Day 1 Retention
metrics.description_hint: % of new users who return the day after their first session. Measures whether the product delivers enough value on day 0 to bring users back.
metrics.sql_template: WITH first_seen AS (SELECT {user_col}, MIN(DATE({time_col})) AS first_date FROM {table} GROUP BY 1), returned AS (SELECT DISTINCT f.{user_col} FROM first_seen f JOIN {table} e ON e.{user_col} = f.{user_col} WHERE DATE(e.{time_col}) = f.first_date + INTERVAL '1 day') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT first_seen.{user_col}) AS cohort_size, COUNT(DISTINCT returned.{user_col}) AS retained, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT returned.{user_col}) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT first_seen.{user_col}), 0), 1) AS d1_retention_pct FROM first_seen LEFT JOIN returned ON returned.{user_col} = first_seen.{user_col}

metrics.name: Day 7 Retention
metrics.description_hint: % of new users who return on day 7. Key predictor of long-term retention. Consumer benchmark: 25%+. SaaS benchmark: 40%+.
metrics.sql_template: WITH first_seen AS (SELECT {user_col}, MIN(DATE({time_col})) AS first_date FROM {table} GROUP BY 1), returned AS (SELECT DISTINCT f.{user_col} FROM first_seen f JOIN {table} e ON e.{user_col} = f.{user_col} WHERE DATE(e.{time_col}) = f.first_date + INTERVAL '7 days') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT first_seen.{user_col}) AS cohort_size, COUNT(DISTINCT returned.{user_col}) AS retained, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT returned.{user_col}) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT first_seen.{user_col}), 0), 1) AS d7_retention_pct FROM first_seen LEFT JOIN returned ON returned.{user_col} = first_seen.{user_col}

metrics.name: Day 30 Retention
metrics.description_hint: % of new users who return on day 30. Strongest signal of true product-market fit. If D30 is healthy, the product has found a lasting use case.
metrics.sql_template: WITH first_seen AS (SELECT {user_col}, MIN(DATE({time_col})) AS first_date FROM {table} GROUP BY 1), returned AS (SELECT DISTINCT f.{user_col} FROM first_seen f JOIN {table} e ON e.{user_col} = f.{user_col} WHERE DATE(e.{time_col}) = f.first_date + INTERVAL '30 days') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT first_seen.{user_col}) AS cohort_size, COUNT(DISTINCT returned.{user_col}) AS retained, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT returned.{user_col}) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT first_seen.{user_col}), 0), 1) AS d30_retention_pct FROM first_seen LEFT JOIN returned ON returned.{user_col} = first_seen.{user_col}

metrics.name: New Users
metrics.description_hint: Users appearing for the first time — the top of the funnel. Track daily to catch acquisition spikes or drops tied to campaigns.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT DATE({time_col}) AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT {user_col}) AS new_users FROM {table} WHERE {event_col} = '{matched_event}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Activation Rate
metrics.description_hint: % of new users who complete the key activation event — the moment they first experience the product's core value. Most critical metric for early-stage products.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN {event_col} = '{matched_event}' THEN {user_col} END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT {user_col}), 0), 1) AS activation_rate_pct FROM {table}

metrics.name: User Churn Rate
metrics.description_hint: % of previously active users who showed no activity in the current period. Inverse of retention. Even small churn rates compound badly over time.
metrics.sql_template: WITH prev AS (SELECT DISTINCT {user_col} FROM {table} WHERE DATE({time_col}) BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '31 days'), curr AS (SELECT DISTINCT {user_col} FROM {table} WHERE DATE({time_col}) >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT prev.{user_col}) AS prev_users, COUNT(DISTINCT curr.{user_col}) AS curr_users, ROUND((1 - COUNT(DISTINCT curr.{user_col}) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT prev.{user_col}), 0)) * 100, 1) AS churn_rate_pct FROM prev LEFT JOIN curr ON curr.{user_col} = prev.{user_col}

metrics.name: Referral Rate
metrics.description_hint: % of users who referred at least one other user. Strong referral programs have rates above 5%. Tracks organic growth flywheel.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN {event_col} = '{matched_event}' THEN {user_col} END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT {user_col}), 0), 1) AS referral_rate_pct FROM {table}

metrics.name: Feature Adoption Rate
metrics.description_hint: % of active users who have used a specific feature at least once. Low adoption signals discoverability issues or unclear value proposition.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT '{matched_event}' AS feature, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN {event_col} = '{matched_event}' THEN {user_col} END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT {user_col}), 0), 1) AS adoption_pct FROM {table}
